title: Ref2VA off-screen Subject retention
description: A focused single-subject Ref2VA vision fixture for off-screen retention, exact dialogue, and stable speaker identity.

contains: Wait here. I'll only be a minute.

humanReview: Is Subject 1 visibly present only before she exits the classroom doorway?
After exiting, does Subject 1 remain fully off-screen rather than being brought visually back into frame?
Does the camera remain in the hallway instead of following her inside?
Is the exact dialogue spoken by the same Subject only after she is fully off-screen?
Does retention_analysis count only visible appearances of Subject 1 rather than treating off-screen speech as visual retention?
If speaker IDs are used, is the speaker identity stable for Subject 1?
Is the Reference Sheet used as identity evidence rather than reproduced as a target grid or panel composition?
Is the requested hallway, doorway, exit, and empty-hallway sequence preserved without unrelated story invention?
